decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Given the location of the site in Hounslow Town Centre, and the close proximity to public transport, the site is a preferred location for employment generating uses. It has not been established that there is sufficient reason to justify the loss of the existing employment use of the site, and for this reason the proposal fails to comply with adopted Unitary Development Plan policy E.1.5 (Development involving loss of or changes in employment uses).

Condition : 2 - The existing office building and curtilage is in principle unacceptable for residential conversion, due to its inappropriate siting, design and layout and because of the environmental condition of this commercial area. The proposal would therefore fail to provide an adequate standard of living accommodation, which would result in harm to future occupants' living conditions, by reason of noise and disturbance, inadequate outlook, inadequate privacy, poor safety and security and due to the lack of any form of private amenity space. The proposal is therefore contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.9 (Safety and Security), E.1.5 (Development Involving Loss of or Changes in Employment Uses), H.1.1 (Location of New Housing Development), H.3.5 (Release of employment uses to residential) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines).
description: Erection of an additional 2 storeys and coversion to 18 self contained flats.
